description: Delney, Streetwise Lookout + Spellseeker: Spellseeker's ETB 'may search for an instant/sorcery MV<=2' trigger is a power-1 creature's triggered ability, so Delney doubles it. Casting Spellseeker so its ETB genuinely fires produces two independently-targeted library searches, finding two DIFFERENT cards (Opt and Shock) - the strongest available demonstration that the instances are not collapsible into one. Validates INT-0010.
artificial_state_elements: 3 Island were scaffolding to cast Spellseeker ({2}{U}); the mana source's identity is not material to the rule under test.

Opt and Shock were chosen as two arbitrary, cheap, distinct instant/sorcery cards for the library to make the 'two different finds' demonstration possible - any two qualifying cards would work identically.
No other permanents, hand cards, or players' boards were modeled.
material_characteristics: Spellseeker's power is exactly 1, so its own triggered ability qualifies for Delney's power-2-or-less doubling clause

Spellseeker's ETB is 'may search... reveal... put into hand... then shuffle' - the doubled instances are independently-targeted library searches, each with its own separate 'may search' choice and its own separate target card
Delney's static ability produces two independently-resolved instances; per the official Delney ruling, target choices are made separately for each instance
abstracted_characteristics: Identity of the specific mana source used to cast Spellseeker
All board state not directly involved in the interaction
The specific two cards chosen to find (Opt, Shock) - any two distinct qualifying cards demonstrate the same point

illegal_actions_to_reject: Any implicit assumption that Spellseeker's ETB only finds one card (Delney alone) rather than up to two

Modeling the two instances as a single 'search for 2 cards' effect rather than two separately-targeted, separately-optional searches (which could, per instance, decline, or find the same card twice if duplicates exist)
expected.outcome_if_resolved: After casting Spellseeker and resolving both doubled ETB instances (finding Opt with the first, Shock with the second): both Opt and Shock are in seat 1's hand.

rules_citations: CR 603.2d (a triggered ability may be stated to trigger an additional time; determine how many times, then trigger that many times)
CR 603.3b (a player puts each of their own simultaneously-pending triggered abilities on the stack in any order they choose)
